2G534AG2aEjhpvAKxabPBJUjBw58WeroJVt3Y2QH.name: BRYMM is a launchpad on Raydium LaunchLab where every trade builds its own coin's market. Each trade pays one 0.89% fee: 0.25% Raydium protocol, a 0.48% creator fee and a 0.16% platform fee. The creator fee splits into 0.16% for the coin's own market and 0.32% for its creator. From the platform fee, 20% buys $BRYMM on the market and burns it, and 20% is assigned to $BRYMM stakers. $BRYMM buybacks are funded by the platform fee, the creator fee on $BRYMM's own curve and, after graduation, its Raydium CPMM creator fee. Every buy and every burn is listed on the Burn Ledger with its transaction.
